observations.limitations: This chunk is a complete, standalone Django management command. No other hunks are supplied, so no relationship to other changes or shared dependencies can be established. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new Django management command that scans database rows for workflow, template, and function records, and replaces a specified URL string with a replacement URL inside JSON content fields. It supports dry-run, team-scoped or all-teams, batched updates, and row-level locking. On each row, it performs a database read, rewrites the JSON, updates the row, and optionally publishes
observations.posthog_connection: This command could help PostHog maintainers or platform operators replace asset URLs after a migration or rebrand, without relying on the application's normal save-path. It could also help prevent stale cached worker behavior by invalidating worker caches when the underlying asset URL changes.

observations.behavior: Adds a test file P1.F2.H1 with tests for the rewrite_email_asset_url command, including checks for ambiguous team scopes, invalid batch sizes, failed row handling, team isolation, and idempotency.
observations.code_quote: # Without this guard a run that forgets --team-id rewrites every team's workflows.
observations.posthog_connection: These assertions guard against unsafe behavior in the email asset URL rewriting workflow, which could otherwise rewrite workflows across unintended teams or fail silently. The tests demonstrate checks for team isolation and failure handling, but do not show the implementation of those safeguards.
